name: HOMICHEF 3-Piece Stainless Steel Steamer Set
imageAlt: Illustration of a stainless steel steamer pot set
description: The original site labeled this link as a stainless steel skillet. The Amazon listing is a HOMICHEF 3-piece stainless steel steamer set. HOMICHEF 3 PCS Whole Food Steamer Set - Nickel Free Stainless Steel Veggie Steam Pot (9.5" Large Vegetable Steamer Insert With Lid, 8" Steam Pot)
features: WHOLE FOOD STEAMING IS THE BEST WAY OF COOKING - Steaming Whole Food (whole chicken, whole veggies, whole lobster, etc.) by wrapping it with hot vapor in an enclosed space is the best way of cooking: retain nutrition without loss of flavor. - This elegant mirror polished steamer set includes 9.5" steamer insert, 8" steam pot, and 9.5" glass lid - Easily meets a whole family's (4-6 people) daily need - 4.5" Deep 3-ridge steamer insert creates 5QT large capacity, great for steaming whole food.

FEATURED 4.5" DEEP 3-RIDGE STEAMER INSERT - Tapered 3-ridge insert is 4.5" deep (deeper than competitors of the same width) - Enlarges the steaming capacity to 5 quart; also concentrates heat at bottom & creates the elevated steaming surface to surround food for whole food steaming - 3 graduated ridges fit 9.5" / 9" / 8" tapered or straight pots and allow for a stable placement - The universal insert fits well with 4QT steam pot included in the set and possibly your other pots or pans.

NICKEL FREE HARM FREE - Made of food grade Japanese standard JYH21CT (21/0) nickel free stainless steel: non-toxic, non-allergic, and more energy savings. - Nickel-bearing stainless steel (e.g., 304 SS) is also commonly used for cookware, BUT nickel is high up on the ATSDR list of priority toxins (causing allergy and diseases), and nickel LEACHES under regular cooking conditions. - Nickel free SS is not only healthier, but also more heat-conductive hence more energy savings (12-15%).

ALSO VERSATILE AS DRAINER BASKET & TABLEWARE - The steamer insert can be used together with the steam pot as a well-sized drainer basket, thanks to its deep perforated 3-ridge design. - You can steam food in this steamer and then put the steamer insert directly on a plate to serve (making itself a sleek tableware). - This is definitely a time saver and allows you to use fewer gadgets in kitchen. - This elegant mirror polished steamer set cuts a fine figure both in kitchen and at dining table.

DEVOTED CUSTOMER SERVICE - Genuine HOMICHEF stainless steel cookware products, certified by ISO9001, BSCI, etc. - TRADEMARK filed in U.S.A. - In business since 1998 - This product comes with 1-MONTH trial period & LIFE-TIME Customer Service - You can always come to us for discounted parts, cooking consultations, and customer service at HOMICHEF store on Amazon.
